entity.name: The Flora-Bama Yacht Club
entity.address_line_1: 17350 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA
entity.editorial_summary: Relaxed, open-air restaurant on the beach featuring creative seafood dishes, cocktails & live music.
entity.description: The Flora-Bama Yacht Club has become almost as legendary as the bar across the street. Guest and food critics are always amazed at the unique and scrumptious offerings on the menu. When you combine the food with the warm service, fantastic waterfront settings and live music... well it doesn't get any better. Located on the line between Orange Beach and Perdido Key, the Flora-Bama Yacht Club is a "Must Visit Often" location on the coast. At the Flora-Bama Yacht Club we pride ourselves in using fresh local seafood and locally grown ingredients. Our team takes the time to seek out area farms and seafood houses who believe in the same fresh standards. We also participate in the Oyster Shell Recycling Program because we strive to better our local environment. The program will recycle oyster shells from restaurants and get them back into Alabama waters, enhancing oyster production among other benefits. You can come by boat, car, paddleboard, float... as long as you get here. We are known for our original menu items and local seafood. There is something for almost everyone. Our award winning Chefs and the friendly staff make every dining experience fun. We have large outdoor deck and beach area. Relax on our sand and listen to the fantastic music from local and visiting musicians. Nothing like a dinner and Bushwacker at the FBYC. We are proud to offer local Isle Dauphine Oysters at all Flora-Bama locations. Sample one of the best southern delicacies.

items.name: Seared Yellowfin Tuna Sashimi
items.description: Yellowfin tuna with Creole wasabi, Sriracha mayo and hoisin.

items.name: Gulf Coast Blue Crab Claws
items.description: Half pound of blue crab claws either fried or sautéed in our lemon cream sauce.

items.name: Smoked Tuna Dip
items.description: Fresh local tuna, hardwood smoked, served with specialty crackers.

items.name: Firecracker Calamari
items.description: Panko-fried calamari drizzled in our house firecracker aioli and sweet chili sauce.

items.name: Greek Shrimp Nachos
items.description: Fried wonton chips smothered in a spinach and feta cream sauce topped with grilled American shrimp, tomatoes, crumbled feta, Kalamata olives, peppadews, banana peppers, green onion and red onion.

items.name: Crab & Parmesan Hash Puppies
items.description: Deep-fried hashbrowns, local blue crab and mashed potatoes folded with Parmesan and Créole seasoning served with chipotle bacon ranch.

items.name: Greek Chicken Flatbread
items.description: Greek marinated chicken, spinach and feta cream sauce, feta cheese, and Greek marinated vegetables on a crispy flatbread.

items.name: Firecracker Coconut Shrimp
items.description: Coconut-crust American shrimp topped with our in-house firecracker aioli and sweet chili sauce.

items.name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
items.description: The savory flavors of roasted red peppers and ground chickpeas. Served with grilled pita bread.

items.name: Asian Ahi Tuna Nachos
items.description: Crispy wontons topped with ahi tuna, sweet soy glaze, wasabi cucumber aioli, shredded Asian slaw and spicy mayo.

items.name: Yacht Club Char-Grilled Oysters
items.description: Char-grilled oysters topped with our world famous Orleans cream, Parmesan cheese and garlic butter.

items.name: Bienville Oysters
items.description: Char-grilled Oysters topped with a creole shrimp sauce, diced bacon, green onions and parmesan cheese.

items.name: Oyster Sampler
items.description: 3 oyster each of Oysters McClellan, Chargrilled , Rockefeller and Bienville.

items.name: Raw Gulf Oysters
items.description: Fresh oysters served on the half shell.

items.name: Oysters Rockefeller
items.description: Char-grilled oysters topped with creamy Rockefeller sauce.

items.name: Oysters McClellan
items.description: The Flora-Bama's original grilled oyster! Gulf oysters topped with green onion, bacon, and melted smoked gouda.

items.name: Our World Famous Gumbo
items.description: Traditional roux based gumbo with house made shrimp stock. Loaded with Conecuh sausage and American shrimp.
